description: An UNSAFE program: a block retypes an *instance variable* rather than a local. `run { @x = "s" }` then `@x + 1` really raises TypeError. The ivar twin of xc-block-retypes-capture, and it checks a different premise: the block body is judged with the enclosing ivar spine, and closCall/yieldExpr require that spine to come back unchanged. Permanent negative target.
sorbet_note: Method `run` uses `yield` but does not mention a block parameter
